subject: Implementation MAP & Cutover cadence - NovaHealth
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Kevin Owen <kevin.owens@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation MAP & Cutover cadence - NovaHealth

Hi Kevin —

Congrats again on signing; excited to get NovaHealth into production with Redwood. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a redlined SOW for your review (SOW_redlined.pdf). The MAP embeds the post-signature implementation plan: rollout phases, canary window, migration freeze, and training cadence.

High-level proposal (dates tentative, call to finalize):
- Design workshop (2hrs): week of 2026-09-07
- Canary window (limited traffic, 2 weeks): 2026-09-21 – 2026-10-04
- Migration & cutover (data sync + switch): target 2026-10-15
- Training (admin + dev): two sessions 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-12

Action items for kickoff:
1) Please confirm preferred kickoff date (we can do 09/07 or 09/09).
2) Procurement contact for SOW sign-off — I’ve cc'd Marissa to help coordinate.
3) Traffic profile & QPS target for canary (Aditya will size capacity once we have numbers).

We plan to run the canary against a dedicated pool (reserved slots) and use staged rollbacks if any regression is detected. The MAP includes acceptance criteria and evaluation checkpoints for each phase — perf SLOs, latency gates, and quality evals tied to your test set.

I’ll propose a short agenda for the kickoff once you confirm the date.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Success Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (worksheet: milestones), SOW_redlined.pdf
From: Kevin Owen <kevin.owens@novahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Larson <susan.larson@novahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Implementation MAP & Cutover cadence - NovaHealth

Thanks Jasmine — appreciate the clear plan. 09/07 works for a kickoff but can you do 09/09 as a fallback? Our procurement lead (Susan) is looped in for the SOW.

A couple of quick notes after a brief internal sync:
- We prefer a slightly longer canary to 3 weeks if possible (we have some seasonality spikes in early Oct).
- For migration, we'd like a one-week cutover window (prep + switch + verification) rather than a single day.
- Training: can we make the second session a hands-on workshop for integrators?

I'll pull the initial QPS and sample dataset for evaluation by EOD 09/02.

Kevin
Kevin Owen
Director, Platform Engineering | NovaHealth Solutions
kevin.owens@novahealth.com | +1 (617) 555-9876

Thanks Kevin — 09/07 confirmed as primary kickoff, 09/09 as backup. Per your ask we’ll extend the canary to 3 weeks and model a one-week migration window in the MAP. I updated MAP_v1.xlsx with the revised windows and acceptance gates; highlights below:

Updated milestones (draft):
- Kickoff / Design workshop (90 min): 2026-09-07 10:00 PT
- Environment provisioning & baseline tests: 2026-09-08 – 2026-09-14
- Canary (limited traffic, expanded): 2026-09-21 – 2026-10-11
- Migration prep & dry run: 2026-10-12 – 2026-10-14
- Cutover week (final migration + verification): 2026-10-15 – 2026-10-22
- Training: 2026-10-05 (admin overview), 2026-10-12 (hands-on workshop)

Acceptance checkpoints (examples):
- Canary day 3: baseline throughput within 10% of target, P50 latency < 120ms
- Canary week 1: no more than 2% error rate on production-like traces
- Final sign-off: successful run of 3 smoke tests and green security checklist

Aditya — can you confirm capacity reservation for the canary pool and add the capacity_plan.xlsx to this thread? Marissa — want to coordinate SOW sign-off and payment milestones with Susan.

I also added a HubSpot link to the MAP in the Related Links for tracking.

Thanks,
Jasmine

Thanks team — added capacity_plan.xlsx (internal sizing) to the thread. Quick notes from infra/serving runtime side:

- We can reserve a dedicated canary pool of 4 cards (A100-equivalent) for the 3-week window; estimated headroom supports up to ~350 QPS sustained for the evaluated model while staying within the latency gates Jasmine outlined.
- If NovaHealth expects higher QPS during the canary we’ll need to add burst capacity or increase the pool size; please send a daily 95th percentile QPS estimate.
- We will instrument prefix/KV caching for warm paths and enable continuous batching at a lower max_batch_latency for the canary to get realistic latency profiles.

Kevin — can you share a small sample of the production traces and the expected peak QPS by 09/02 so we can finalize the hardware reservation?

Aditya Rao
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai
